summary: Plutus Financial Group, a Nasdaq-listed Cayman holding company, furnished a 6-K disclosing a Fourth Amendment to its July 9, 2025 merger agreement with Choco Up Group Holdings Limited, extending the Outside Date from September 30, 2026 to December 31, 2026. Plutus will acquire all outstanding Choco Up equity for newly issued Class A and Class B ordinary shares, in a private placement exempt under the Securities Act. Closing remains conditioned on Nasdaq approval of the listing application, with prior extensions in December 2025, March 2026 and June 2026. Watch Nasdaq clearance timing and any further delay risk to deal completion.
